narrator_hint: seventh-storyteller / ending routes: several characters; work out the speaker from context

rows.en: As she said this, Iwashita stared at me, her eyes glittering with an ugly light.{p}
Before I knew it, her hand was gripping a box cutter.

Click-click-click...
With a grating sound, the silver blade slid out.
...I have to run!
I knew it, but I only grew more frantic, and my body wouldn't obey me.
My hands and my feet were frozen in place, stuck in the pose of sitting in my chair.
...Why?
All I did was want a sweetheart. Why is this happening to me?
Iwashita gently laid a hand on my shoulder...
and whispered in a kind voice.{p}

"It's all right.
It'll be over in a moment...
You'll be with Mr. Kawaguchi very soon.
It only hurts for an instant."
As her lukewarm breath brushed over me, a sweet scent drifted up...
...the scent of a flower the color of blood.
"This is how I got to meet him, too.
I'm so glad I've made a friend..."{p}
With that, Iwashita raised the box cutter high.{p}

Her throat split wide open, and bright red blood came gushing out of it.
...Ah, a bright red flower.
A flower of bright red blood is blooming...

I felt heat along the side of my neck.
But that, too, lasted only an instant.{p}

Because the next moment, a spray of bright red blood was bursting from my neck too...
<Red...
The bright red color of blood...!
The color of the flowers I always wanted...☆>
As my consciousness slipped away...{p}
The last thing I heard was the shrill, convulsive laughter of a man whose voice I didn't recognize...........{p}

All right.
You want to go out with Sumiyoshi.
He's such a pure-hearted, innocent boy.
I think you and he would make a perfect couple, {a}.
Let's see...
If there's any obstacle, it's just one thing...
The fact that he's a ghost, I suppose.
You see, he died in an accident right after the entrance ceremony.
The first time I met him...
Sumiyoshi was standing at the school gate, peering inside the whole time.
I'd like to go in...
But would I get in trouble...?
...That was the feeling he gave off.
So I called out to him.
"Why not just walk right in?"
...like that.{p}

You seem unsure.
Maybe you don't need a sweetheart just yet, {a}.
Heh heh heh...
There's no need to worry.
You'll find someone wonderful soon enough.
Someone who will love you more than anyone else in this world.{p}

Heh heh, so that's how it is.
Right now you're in love with someone who doesn't know it yet.
Tell me, {a}...
The person you like must be someone wonderful.{p}If you don't mind... won't you tell me that person's name?
Actually...
...It's a secret

"Actually..."
...Should I just say it?{p}

"Actually...?"
Iwashita was gazing at me with a smile.
"Actually, the one I like is...
you, Iwashita!"{p}

...Oh. Everyone was staring at me, their mouths hanging open.
'What a weird girl...'
That's what they seemed to be saying.
How mean. That was a sincere confession of love...
.................................... Nobody said a single word.
Iwashita just stared at me, without any expression.
...Is she appalled after all?
The moment that thought crossed my mind...{p}

Iwashita broke into a bright smile.
"Tell me, {a}...
Do you really mean that?{p}Can I... believe what you just said?"
I'm serious
Actually... I was joking

"Yes, of course I'm serious.
Please believe me."
I said it firmly.
Because I really do love her.
To think someone so attractive and wonderful had been at this school all along...
Today was the first time... I'd only just met her a little while ago, and yet my heart wouldn't stop pounding.
I'd meant to pour that feverish feeling into those few words, but...{p}

"...I see."
Iwashita lowered her eyes.
And then...
"...I'm sorry.
I can't return your feelings."
She murmured it briefly, in a small voice.
...It looked like my feelings hadn't reached her after all.{p}

"But don't get the wrong idea.
It isn't because I dislike you, {a}.
There's a deep reason behind this...
I'll tell you about it."
Iwashita took one deep breath, then began to speak, haltingly.{p}

Iwashita sat perfectly still, barely breathing.
...Is she angry?
I did say something weird...
I like Iwashita, but that feeling is on a completely different level from romance.
"I see..."
Iwashita murmured briefly, then let out a sigh.
And then...{p}

"And here I got my hopes up for nothing.
I'd taken a liking to you too, {a}..."
...Oh no, she really is angry.
She's kind of scary...
"...But I think it's better for you this way.
Because people who get close to me end up unhappy.{p}

Heh heh heh...
You probably can't believe it, hearing something like this so suddenly...
Yes, let me tell you the story."
With a meaningful smile, Iwashita began to speak, haltingly.{p}

"...It's a secret."
Turning bright red, that was the best answer I could manage.
The name of the person I like is top secret.
If I let it slip in a place like this, they'd tease me to no end.
"Oh my, {b}, you've gone all red!"
"Isn't that cute?
Such a natural reaction..."
Hearing them talk like that only made my face burn hotter.{p}

Seeing me like that, Iwashita giggled.
"My, {a}...
There's no need to be shy.
Heh heh heh heh...
I hope your feelings come true.
I hope that person becomes the best sweetheart you could ever have..."{p}

That was when strange things began to happen around me.
Because Yuya had come back to me...{p}

A boy who bumped into me in the hallway was sent flying five meters and slammed into the wall.
And our shoulders had barely even brushed.
The art club member who painted my portrait broke an arm...
The boy who lent me a book fell down the stairs and broke a bone.
One eerie accident after another kept happening around me.
Before long, nobody would come near me.
I was worn out, too, somehow...
Little by little, I came to live in fear of the voices and visions I saw and heard.
I'd grown terribly afraid of meeting people...{p}

...But even so, someone appeared who was kind to me.
A boy in my year...
What was his name again...?
He said he liked me...
That he was serious, so I should believe him...
He said it with an earnest face, too.
It was the first time anyone had said something like that to me since Yuya died.
I was happy...
Yuya would understand about this one.
Surely he would forgive me...
That's what I thought.
...But that was just my own selfish assumption.{p}

I mean, think about it.
There's no way he would die and leave me behind, when he loved me more than anyone.
He died because of me.
Yuya kept his promise and came back even after death, and then I had a change of heart, so Yuya got angry.
The accidents that had kept happening until then were all Yuya's doing, too.{p}
With that, Iwashita suddenly stood up.{p}

"{a}...
You said just now that you love me, didn't you?
Yuya is furious with you.
He says he won't forgive you, even if you are a girl..."
With a sorrowful smile, Iwashita walked toward me.
Then she suddenly thrust out both arms and seized me by the neck.
"Stop!"
"What are you doing★"
The startled members rushed in to stop her.
But even with three boys trying to hold her down, they were no match for her strength.
"I... Iwashi...ta...?"
Such incredible strength...
...This is no woman's strength!
"I'm sorry.
...There's nothing I can do."
With tears welling in her eyes, Iwashita tightened her arms around my throat.
"But let me say just one thing.
For telling someone like me that you love me.................................... thank you."
A single tear fell from Iwashita's eyes and wet my face.{p}
As my vision blurred, I saw a huge black shadow writhing behind Iwashita.{p}

<Ha ha ha...
This is what happens to anyone who lays a hand on my precious fiancée>
The shadow was laughing, its bright red mouth gaping open...{p}

...I see. So you're a weak person.
That's no good.
You have to become stronger...
Otherwise, you'll end up like me.
I used to be a weak person too...{p}

You can't believe it, you say?
No, you have to believe me!{p}

Listen.
If you don't want something horrible to happen to you, you'd better heed people's warnings.
You believe my story.
...Understand?
Now, nod for me.......... That's good.{p}

Spirits, you see, hate having their existence denied.
More than anyone, they want people to notice that they exist.
Yuya is the same.
Normally he wouldn't do anything to harm people, but...
If you deny his existence in a single word, calling him a 'dream' or an 'illusion,' he gets terribly angry.{p}

Heh heh heh...
Oh, {a}, you still look like you can't believe it.
But it's all right, isn't it?
After all, you nodded just now to say you believe me.{p}

"Um...
Would someone please take a look for me...?"
"All right, I'll go."
With that, a boy sitting by the window stood up.
The boy opened the window and peered down, and...{p}

"Someone's down there!"
He let out an especially loud shout.
"What★"
Everyone jumped up at once and rushed to the window.{p}

"It's true...☆"
Right below the window, a boy lay face down.
His unnaturally twisted arms and legs stood out pale white in the darkness.
"Oh no!
Somebody jumped!"
People quickly gathered around the boy.
We'd probably hear an ambulance siren any minute now...
As I was thinking that...
"It's my fault..."
The one who murmured that, staring down from the window, was Iwashita.
In her eyes, deep sorrow was mixed with a cold light.
"Now, everyone, take your seats.
I'll go on with my story..."{p}
Urged on by Iwashita's words, we left the window and went back to our seats.{p}

"Everyone who gets close to me meets with misfortune."
Iwashita began to speak, haltingly.{p}

...The one lying down there was Yoshino, without a doubt.
He once gave me a love letter.
Yes, of course I turned him down.
'I already have a sweetheart'... I told him.
That was during lunch break today.
But Yoshino just wouldn't give up.
"Liar!
There's no way you have a sweetheart☆"
...he insisted...
And then...
I felt as though something swayed behind me.
Ah, Yuya is angry...
That's what I thought.
So I pushed Yoshino away, coldly.
"I hate your guts!"
...like that.
I thought that way I could keep him from coming to harm.
After all, everyone who gets close to me, everyone who does me harm, meets with some ill-omened accident.
I thought that if I treated him coldly, Yuya's anger would subside.
...But it seems I was naive.
Yoshino is dead.
Was it because of Yuya's anger...?
Or was it suicide, from the shock of being rejected...?
So now there's one more unfortunate person around me.{p}

Heh heh heh...
{a}...
You may be in danger too, you know.
Because anyone who gets involved with me ends up in danger.{p}

Be careful.
Try not to make me angry, or cause me trouble...
I do hope you all stay alive until the seventh story is over.
Well then, that's the end of my story...
...Whose turn is next?{p}

Heh heh heh...
...Thank you.
You should have a love like this too, {a}.
He binds me only because he loves me that much...{p}

My, how can you say such a thing!
{a}...
Are you making fun of true love?

Heh heh, he's very angry indeed.
You'd better be careful, {a}...
You're... in danger.
Don't blame me if something horrible happens to you.
Anyway, my story ends here.
Heh heh heh...
I hope you make it safely to the very last story.
Now, let's hurry on to the next one.........{p}
That was exactly three years ago today...{p}
